title: Google Gemini 4 Neon is now available on Unity Gateway
body:
Google [Gemini 4 Neon](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#gemini-4-neon) is now available on Unity Gateway. Use the model service name `system.ai.gemini-4-neon` in your requests.

Customers are responsible for ensuring their compliance with [applicable terms](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/acceptable-use-models).
